text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove the existing school bus loading zone on Dubray Avenue, north of Wilson Avenue. This recommendation is in consultation with the ward Councillor upon a request from the Toronto District Catholic School Board (TCDSB).

The North York Community Council: 1. Authorized removal of the existing school bus loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. daily, on the east side of Dubray Avenue, from a point 56 metres north of Wilson Avenue to a point 46 metres further north.
